title: ChecksStartedPayload

terminalId.description: The terminal the check runs in, which the environment opened and terminals.subscribe streams while it is open.

command.description: A Workspace check's shell text, kept and run verbatim through the environment's one-off shell (/bin/sh -c on POSIX) in the Workspace directory; at most 16,384 characters, and not white space alone.

anyOf.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

sourceRunId.description: The run whose edits set the check off; null for a manual check.

description: checks.started: a Workspace check began in the terminal named, running the command named; the source run is null for a manual check.
